notes: New Sitemap card on the Dashboard: new links found in the last sync, total links currently in the sitemap, plus updated/removed counts from the last sync. While building it, found and fixed a real bug from the previous update: the 'fix' that switched the Service translation pipeline and Telegram channel queue cards to a plain grid-cols-2 class didn't actually work - that class was never compiled into this app's CSS bundle either (only grid-cols-1 and responsive-prefixed variants are), so their stat tiles were still silently stacking in a single column this whole time. All three cards now use inline grid styles instead, which don't depend on any particular class being compiled, and are confirmed working.
